title: Anima-Engine benchmark baseline report (M0.4)
description: Shape of benchmark_report.json produced by scripts/bench_baseline.mjs. Captures the reproducibility envelope (seed + config + hardware) plus a timings block. Target hardware is an Intel Core i5-14600KF as of 2026-07-26 (the earlier Dell Vostro 3530 declaration is void). Timings keyed `criterion/*` are real per-system measurements from `cargo bench --bench tick_systems`; `*_fbm_proxy` entries are a harness self-test. Perf numbers are still NOT locked, because what is measured is a lower bound on a tick rather than a frame (WORLD_SIMULATION_PLAN.md §10.2, BENCHMARK_BASELINE.md). Extra top-level fields (schemaVersion, timestampNote, proxyChecksum, notes, …) are allowed.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this report schema the file conforms to.

timestampNote.description: Capture note, NOT a machine clock read. Default 'set on capture'.

gridDim.description: Backend sim grid cells per side (DEFAULT_GRID_DIM = 128).

tickHz.description: Fixed physics tick rate in Hz (TICK_HZ = 60).

cpuModel.description: Model string of the first CPU (os.cpus()[0].model).

timings.description: Named measurements. Non-empty. Each entry carries ms, iterations and a note. Keys prefixed `criterion/` are real per-system medians (ms is per iteration, so iterations is 1, and medianNs/meanNs/stdDevNs carry the precision that sub-microsecond benchmarks would lose in ms).

iterations.description: Iteration count the ms figure covers.

note.description: What was measured and how to replace it with a real capture.
